# Packages

```{r libraries}

library(tidyverse)
library(plm)            # panel estimators (pooled, FD, FE, TE, 2WE)
library(lmtest)         # coeftest for clustered inference
library(sandwich)       # robust covariance matrices
library(modelsummary)   # publication-quality regression tables
library(kableExtra)     # table styling
library(broom)          # tidy() for plm
library(ggrepel)        # non-overlapping point labels in graphs
```

# Data preparation

$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{early\_x\_agg\_x\_intel\_raw}_{i,t}  &= \mathbf{1}[2016 \le t \le 2019]\;\times\; \text{AIIE}^{\text{agg,raw}}_{i,t}\;\times\;\text{Intel}_t \\
\text{mature\_x\_lm\_x\_intel\_raw}_{i,t} &= \mathbf{1}[t \ge 2020]\;\times\; \text{AIIE}^{\text{LM,raw}}_{i,t}\;\times\;\text{Intel}_t
\end{aligned}
$$

The `early_ai` window captures the **pre-LLM** discriminative-AI era when the
**aggregate** Felten et al. (2021) measure best summarises overall AI exposure.
The `mature_ai` window captures the **generative-AI** era (post-2019) where the
**Language Modeling (LM)** sub-index is the relevant exposure measure for
GPT-style productivity shocks.

```{r load-data}
panel_raw <- read_csv("../Data/Final Data Set/panel_mergedfinal.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("Raw panel dimensions:", nrow(panel_raw), "rows ×",
    ncol(panel_raw), "columns\n")
cat("Year range:", min(panel_raw$year), "–", max(panel_raw$year), "\n")
cat("Industries:", n_distinct(panel_raw$bea_code), "\n")
```

```{r build-panel}
panel <- panel_raw %>%
  filter(industry != "Farms") %>%
  filter(year >= 2016, year <= 2024) %>%
  arrange(bea_code, year) %>%
  mutate(
    # Phase indicators
    early_ai  = as.integer(year >= 2016 & year <= 2019),
    mature_ai = as.integer(year >= 2020),

    # Triple interactions using RAW AIIE (key regressors) 
    early_x_agg_x_intel_raw  = early_ai  * aggregate_raw_aiie * intelligence_index,
    mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw  = mature_ai * lm_raw_aiie        * intelligence_index,
    mature_x_ig_x_intel_raw  = mature_ai * ig_raw_aiie        * intelligence_index, 

    #  - Symmetric placebo terms (used only in the symmetry check)
    early_x_lm_x_intel_raw   = early_ai  * lm_raw_aiie        * intelligence_index,
    mature_x_agg_x_intel_raw = mature_ai * aggregate_raw_aiie * intelligence_index,
    covid_dummy = as.integer(year %in% c(2020, 2021)),
    wfh_x_covid = wfh_index * covid_dummy,
    
    #  - Lag of employment (log)  
    log_employment_lag1 = ifelse(is.na(employment_lag1) | employment_lag1 <= 0,
                                 NA_real_, log(employment_lag1))
  )

cat("Working panel:\n")
cat("  Rows:", nrow(panel), "\n")
cat("  Industries:", n_distinct(panel$bea_code), "\n")
cat("  Years:", paste(sort(unique(panel$year)), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

panel %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    N_total          = n(),
    N_with_lp        = sum(!is.na(ln_lp)),
    N_with_lag_emp   = sum(!is.na(log_employment_lag1)),
    N_with_all_ctrls = sum(complete.cases(across(c(ln_lp,
                                                   ict_capital_contrib,
                                                   non_ict_capital_contrib,
                                                   eng_contrib,
                                                   log_employment_lag1,
                                                   early_x_agg_x_intel_raw,
                                                   mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw))))
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Observations available by year (unbalanced panel)")
```

```{r pdata-frame}
# Converting to a panel data frame

pdata <- pdata.frame(panel, index = c("bea_code", "year"))

cat("plm panel structure:\n")
pdim(pdata)
```

# Model specification

The dependent variable is the log of the labor productivity index $\ln(LP)_{i,t}$.
The benchmark equation is

$$
\ln LP_{i,t} = \beta_1\,\text{early\_x\_agg\_x\_intel\_raw}_{i,t}
            + \beta_2\,\text{mature\_x\_lm\_x\_intel\_raw}_{i,t}
            + \boldsymbol{\gamma}'\mathbf{X}_{i,t}
            + \alpha_i + \delta_t + u_{i,t}
$$

with controls $\mathbf{X}_{i,t}$ comprising the **ICT-capital contribution**,
**non-ICT capital contribution**, **energy-input contribution**, and
**lagged log employment**. $\alpha_i$ are industry fixed effects, $\delta_t$
are year fixed effects.

```{r common-formula}

fml <- ln_lp ~ early_x_agg_x_intel_raw + mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw +
               ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib + eng_contrib +
               log_employment_lag1
```

Standard errors are **clustered at the industry level** (`bea_code`) in every
specification, using the panel-robust Arellano (1987) covariance matrix
implemented in `plm::vcovHC(..., cluster = "group", type = "HC1")`. This is
the appropriate cluster-robust estimator for short-T unbalanced panels.

```{r se-helper}

clse <- function(mod) {
  vcovHC(mod, method = "arellano", type = "HC1", cluster = "group")
}


ct_print <- function(mod, label) {
  cat("\n========== ", label, " ==========\n")
  print(coeftest(mod, vcov = clse(mod)))
  cat("\nN =", nobs(mod), " | Industries =",
      length(unique(index(mod, "id"))),
      " | Years =", length(unique(index(mod, "time"))), "\n")
}
```

# Estimation

We build up from pooled OLS (no panel structure) to the two-way fixed-effects
specification.

## (1) Pooled OLS

```{r pooled-ols}
m_pool <- plm(fml, data = pdata, model = "pooling")
ct_print(m_pool, "Pooled OLS")
```

## (2) First differences

The FD estimator differences out any time-invariant industry heterogeneity and,
importantly, is robust to a unit root in $\ln LP$ — useful given that
productivity indexes are typically near-integrated.

```{r first-diff}
m_fd <- plm(fml, data = pdata, model = "fd")
ct_print(m_fd, "First Differences")
```

## (3) Industry fixed effects only

```{r ind-fe}
m_ife <- plm(fml, data = pdata, model = "within", effect = "individual")
ct_print(m_ife, "Industry FE only")
```

## (4) Year (time) fixed effects only

```{r time-fe}
m_tfe <- plm(fml, data = pdata, model = "within", effect = "time")
ct_print(m_tfe, "Time FE only")
```

## (5) Two-way fixed effects 

```{r twoway-fe}
m_2we <- plm(fml, data = pdata, model = "within", effect = "twoways")
ct_print(m_2we, "Two-way FE")
```

## (6) Two-way fixed effects with Lag of LP 
```{r}
m_2weNEW <- plm(ln_lp ~ early_x_agg_x_intel_raw + mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw +
               ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib + eng_contrib +
               log_employment_lag1 + lag(ln_lp, 1), data = pdata, model = "within", effect = "twoways")
ct_print(m_2weNEW, "Two-way FE (preferred)")

```

# Specification tests


```{r diagnostics-fn}
run_panel_diagnostics <- function(pooled, ife, tfe, twe, formula, pdata) {

  htest_row <- function(test_name, decision_h0, h_obj) {
    stat_val <- as.numeric(h_obj$statistic)
    par      <- h_obj$parameter
    df_str   <- if (length(par) == 2)
                  sprintf("(%g, %g)", par[1], par[2])
                else if (length(par) == 1) sprintf("(%g)", par[1])
                else ""
    p        <- as.numeric(h_obj$p.value)
    tibble(
      Test          = test_name,
      `H 0`          = decision_h0,
      Statistic     = sprintf("%.3f %s", stat_val, df_str),
      `p-value`     = formatC(p, digits = 4, format = "g"),
      Decision      = ifelse(p < 0.05, "Reject H 0 (5%)",
                       ifelse(p < 0.10, "Reject H 0 (10%)", "Fail to reject H 0"))
    )
  }

  # 1. Joint F-tests for fixed-effect significance 
  f_tests <- bind_rows(
    htest_row("Industry FE vs Pooled OLS",  "No industry effects",
              pFtest(ife, pooled)),
    htest_row("Year FE vs Pooled OLS",      "No time effects",
              pFtest(tfe, pooled)),
    htest_row("Two-way FE vs Pooled OLS",   "No effects (jointly)",
              pFtest(twe, pooled)),
    htest_row("Time effects given industry FE", "Year effects redundant after industry FE",
              pFtest(twe, ife))
  )

  # 2. Hausman test (FE vs RE) on individual effects
  m_re_ind <- try(
    plm(formula, data = pdata, model = "random", effect = "individual",
        random.method = "swar"),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  hausman <- if (!inherits(m_re_ind, "try-error")) {
    htest_row("Hausman: industry FE vs RE",
              "RE consistent (orthogonal effects)",
              phtest(ife, m_re_ind))
  } else {
    tibble(Test = "Hausman: industry FE vs RE",
           `H 0` = "RE consistent",
           Statistic = "—",
           `p-value` = "—",
           Decision = "RE estimator failed to converge")
  }

  # 3. Residual autocorrelation in the 2WE model
  serial <- htest_row(
    "Breusch-Godfrey / Wooldridge AR(1)",
    "No serial correlation in errors",
    pbgtest(twe)
  )

  # 4. Cross-sectional dependence (Pesaran)
  csd_obj <- try(pcdtest(twe, test = "cd"), silent = TRUE)
  csd <- if (!inherits(csd_obj, "try-error")) {
    htest_row("Pesaran CD test", "Cross-sectional independence", csd_obj)
  } else {
    tibble(Test = "Pesaran CD test",
           `H 0` = "Cross-sectional independence",
           Statistic = "—", `p-value` = "—",
           Decision = "Could not be computed (panel structure)")
  }

  # 5. Wald tests on the AI coefficients (clustered VCV) 
  wald_chi2 <- function(mod, hyp_vec, label) {
    cf  <- coef(mod); V <- clse(mod)
    R   <- matrix(0, length(hyp_vec), length(cf), dimnames = list(NULL, names(cf)))
    rhs <- numeric(length(hyp_vec))
    for (j in seq_along(hyp_vec)) {
      parts <- strsplit(hyp_vec[j], "=")[[1]] %>% trimws()
      R[j, parts[1]] <- 1
      if (length(parts) == 2 && parts[2] != "0") R[j, parts[2]] <- -1
    }
    Rb <- R %*% cf - rhs
    W  <- as.numeric(t(Rb) %*% solve(R %*% V %*% t(R)) %*% Rb)
    df <- length(hyp_vec)
    p  <- pchisq(W, df, lower.tail = FALSE)
    tibble(
      Test      = label,
      `H 0`      = paste(hyp_vec, collapse = "; "),
      Statistic = sprintf("%.3f (df = %d)", W, df),
      `p-value` = formatC(p, digits = 4, format = "g"),
      Decision  = ifelse(p < 0.05, "Reject H 0 (5%)",
                  ifelse(p < 0.10, "Reject H 0 (10%)", "Fail to reject H 0"))
    )
  }

  wald <- bind_rows(
    wald_chi2(twe,
      c("early_x_agg_x_intel_raw", "mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw"),
      "Joint significance of AI terms"),
    wald_chi2(twe,
      c("early_x_agg_x_intel_raw = mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw"),
      "Early effect = Mature effect")
  )

  list(
    `F-tests for fixed-effect significance`   = f_tests,
    `Hausman test (FE vs RE)`                 = hausman,
    `Residual autocorrelation tests`          = serial,
    `Cross-sectional dependence`              = csd,
    `Wald tests on AI coefficients (2WE)`     = wald
  )
}
```

```{r run-diagnostics}
diag <- run_panel_diagnostics(
  pooled  = m_pool, ife = m_ife, tfe = m_tfe, twe = m_2we,
  formula = fml,    pdata = pdata
)

for (nm in names(diag)) {
  kbl <- kable(diag[[nm]], caption = nm,
               align = c("l","l","r","r","l")) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                  full_width = FALSE, position = "left") |>
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
  print(kbl)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

# Robustness — variations on the two-way FE model

```{r robustness-2we, results='asis'}

# 1. Full panel for the structural-break specification
panel_full <- panel_raw %>%
  filter(industry != "Farms") %>%
  arrange(bea_code, year) %>%
  mutate(
    ai_exposure = aggregate_raw_aiie * intelligence_index,
    covid_dummy = as.integer(year %in% c(2020, 2021)),
    wfh_x_covid = wfh_index * covid_dummy
  )
pdata_full <- pdata.frame(panel_full, index = c("bea_code", "year"))

# 2. Working panel with raw (un-logged) lag of employment
panel_rawlag <- panel %>%
  mutate(
    employment_lag1_clean = ifelse(employment_lag1 <= 0 | is.na(employment_lag1),
                                   NA_real_, employment_lag1),
    covid_dummy = as.integer(year %in% c(2020, 2021)),
    wfh_x_covid = wfh_index * covid_dummy
  )
pdata_rawlag <- pdata.frame(panel_rawlag, index = c("bea_code", "year"))

# 3. Unbalanced AIIE panel
panel_unbal <- panel_raw %>%
  filter(industry != "Farms") %>%
  arrange(bea_code, year) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(aggregate_raw_aiie, lm_raw_aiie, ig_raw_aiie),
           ~ ifelse(. == 0, NA_real_, .)),
    early_ai  = as.integer(year >= 2016 & year <= 2019),
    mature_ai = as.integer(year >= 2020),
    early_x_agg_x_intel_raw  = early_ai  * aggregate_raw_aiie * intelligence_index,
    mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw  = mature_ai * lm_raw_aiie        * intelligence_index,
    mature_x_ig_x_intel_raw  = mature_ai * ig_raw_aiie        * intelligence_index,
    covid_dummy = as.integer(year %in% c(2020, 2021)),
    wfh_x_covid = wfh_index * covid_dummy,
    log_employment_lag1 = ifelse(is.na(employment_lag1) | employment_lag1 <= 0,
                                  NA_real_, log(employment_lag1))
  )
pdata_unbal <- pdata.frame(panel_unbal, index = c("bea_code", "year"))

# 4. Full panel with phase dummies (no employment control) 
panel_full_em <- panel_raw %>%
  filter(industry != "Farms") %>%
  arrange(bea_code, year) %>%
  mutate(
    early_ai  = as.integer(year >= 2016 & year <= 2019),
    mature_ai = as.integer(year >= 2020),
    early_x_agg_x_intel_raw = early_ai  * aggregate_raw_aiie * intelligence_index,
    mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw = mature_ai * lm_raw_aiie        * intelligence_index,
    covid_dummy = as.integer(year %in% c(2020, 2021)),
    wfh_x_covid = wfh_index * covid_dummy
  )
pdata_full_em <- pdata.frame(panel_full_em, index = c("bea_code", "year"))

# ── Models ──

# (1) Baseline
m_aa <- plm(ln_lp ~ early_x_agg_x_intel_raw + mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw +
                   ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib + eng_contrib +
                   log_employment_lag1 + wfh_x_covid,
           data = pdata, model = "within", effect = "twoways")

# (2) Adding Image-Generation AIIE term in the mature period
m2 <- plm(ln_lp ~ early_x_agg_x_intel_raw + mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw +
                  mature_x_ig_x_intel_raw +
                  ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib + eng_contrib +
                  log_employment_lag1 + wfh_x_covid,
          data = pdata, model = "within", effect = "twoways")

# (3) Levels rather than logs of LP
m3 <- plm(lp_index ~ early_x_agg_x_intel_raw + mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw +
                     ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib + eng_contrib +
                     log_employment_lag1 + wfh_x_covid,
          data = pdata, model = "within", effect = "twoways")

# (4) Dropping employment lag
m4 <- plm(ln_lp ~ early_x_agg_x_intel_raw + mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw +
                  ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib + eng_contrib +
                  wfh_x_covid,
          data = pdata, model = "within", effect = "twoways")

# (5) Full 1997–2024 panel with phase dummies
m_f <- plm(ln_lp ~ early_x_agg_x_intel_raw + mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw +
                   ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib + eng_contrib +
                   wfh_x_covid,
           data = pdata_full_em, model = "within", effect = "twoways")

# (6) Single AI×Intel term on full panel
m_b <- plm(ln_lp ~ ai_exposure + ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib +
                   eng_contrib + wfh_x_covid,
           data = pdata_full, model = "within", effect = "twoways")

# (7) Raw lag of employment instead of log
m_c <- plm(ln_lp ~ early_x_agg_x_intel_raw + mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw +
                   ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib + eng_contrib +
                   employment_lag1_clean + wfh_x_covid,
           data = pdata_rawlag, model = "within", effect = "twoways")

# (8) ln(TFP) as the dependent variable
m_d <- plm(ln_tfp ~ early_x_agg_x_intel_raw + mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw +
                    ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib + eng_contrib +
                    log_employment_lag1 + wfh_x_covid,
           data = pdata, model = "within", effect = "twoways")

# (9) Unbalanced AIIE panel 
m_e <- plm(ln_lp ~ early_x_agg_x_intel_raw + mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw +
                   ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib + eng_contrib +
                   log_employment_lag1 + wfh_x_covid,
           data = pdata_unbal, model = "within", effect = "twoways")

# ── Cluster-robust SEs ──
vcov_rob <- list(
  "Baseline 2WE"           = clse(m_aa),
  "Include Image Gen"      = clse(m2),
  "Absolute productivity"  = clse(m3),
  "No emp. control"        = clse(m4),
  "Full panel, phases"     = clse(m_f),
  "One structural break"   = clse(m_b),
  "Raw emp. lag"           = clse(m_c),
  "TFP as DV"              = clse(m_d),
  "AIIE zeros = NA"        = clse(m_e)
)

mods_rob <- list(
  "Baseline 2WE"           = m_aa,
  "Include Image Gen"      = m2,
  "Absolute productivity"  = m3,
  "No emp. control"        = m4,
  "Full panel, phases"     = m_f,
  "One structural break"   = m_b,
  "Raw emp. lag"           = m_c,
  "TFP as DV"              = m_d,
  "AIIE zeros = NA"        = m_e
)

coef_map_rob <- c(
  "early_x_agg_x_intel_raw"  = "Early × Aggregate AIIE × Intel",
  "mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw"  = "Mature × LM AIIE × Intel",
  "mature_x_ig_x_intel_raw"  = "Mature × IG AIIE × Intel",
  "wfh_x_covid"              = "WFH index × COVID dummy",
  "ai_exposure"              = "AIIE × Intel (single term)",
  "ict_capital_contrib"      = "ICT-capital contribution",
  "non_ict_capital_contrib"  = "Non-ICT capital contribution",
  "eng_contrib"              = "Energy contribution",
  "log_employment_lag1"      = "Log employment $_{t-1}$",
  "employment_lag1_clean"    = "Employment $_{t-1}$ (raw)"
)

add_rows_rob <- tibble::tribble(
  ~term,            ~`Baseline 2WE`, ~`Include Image Gen`, ~`Absolute productivity`, ~`No emp. control`, ~`Full panel, phases`, ~`One structural break`, ~`Raw emp. lag`, ~`TFP as DV`, ~`AIIE zeros = NA`,
  "Dependent var",  "ln(LP)",        "ln(LP)",             "LP (level)",             "ln(LP)",           "ln(LP)",              "ln(LP)",                "ln(LP)",        "ln(TFP)",    "ln(LP)",
  "Sample years",   "2017–2024",     "2017–2024",          "2017–2024",              "2017–2024",        "1997–2024",           "1997–2024",             "2017–2024",     "2017–2024",  "2017–2024",
  "Industry FE",    "Yes",           "Yes",                "Yes",                    "Yes",              "Yes",                 "Yes",                   "Yes",           "Yes",        "Yes",
  "Year FE",        "Yes",           "Yes",                "Yes",                    "Yes",              "Yes",                 "Yes",                   "Yes",           "Yes",        "Yes",
  "Cluster (SE)",   "Industry",      "Industry",           "Industry",               "Industry",         "Industry",            "Industry",              "Industry",      "Industry",   "Industry"
)

gof_rob <- tibble::tribble(
  ~raw,            ~clean,            ~fmt,
  "nobs",          "Observations",    0,
  "r.squared",     "R²",              3,
  "adj.r.squared", "Adj. R²",         3
)

raw_rob <- modelsummary(
  mods_rob,
  vcov     = vcov_rob,
  coef_map = coef_map_rob,
  gof_map  = gof_rob,
  add_rows = add_rows_rob,
  stars    = c('*' = .1, '**' = .05, '***' = .01),
  title    = "Robustness: variations on the two-way fixed-effects model (clustered SEs in parentheses)",
  notes    = c(
    "All columns: two-way fixed effects (industry + year), industry-clustered SEs (Arellano HC1).",
    "All columns include WFH × COVID, where COVID = 1 for 2020–2021 and 0 otherwise; identification of this interaction comes from cross-industry variation in WFH exposure during the 2020–2021 window (the COVID dummy alone is absorbed by year FE).",
    "(1) Baseline reproduces column (5) of the main regression table.",
    "(2) Adds the mature × IG AIIE × Intel term to test for image-generation exposure effects.",
    "(3) Levels of the LP index instead of the log.",
    "(4) Drops lagged employment (reverse-causality concern: AI may itself cause employment changes).",
    "(5) Estimates the early/mature decomposition on the full 1997–2024 panel; lagged employment dropped (unavailable pre-2016).",
    "(6) Single AI×Intel term on the 1997–2024 panel; mechanically zero before 2016.",
    "(7) Replaces log(employment_{t-1}) with the raw level.",
    "(8) Substitutes ln(TFP) for ln(LP) as the dependent variable.",
    "(9) Recodes zeros in aggregate / LM / IG raw AIIE as NA, making the panel explicitly unbalanced in AI exposure."
  ),
  output = "kableExtra"
) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "(1)" = 1, "(2)" = 1, "(3)" = 1, "(4)" = 1,
                    "(5)" = 1, "(6)" = 1, "(7)" = 1, "(8)" = 1, "(9)" = 1)) %>%
  as.character()

raw_rob <- gsub("&amp;nbsp;", "", raw_rob, fixed = TRUE)
raw_rob <- gsub("&nbsp;",     "", raw_rob, fixed = TRUE)
raw_rob <- gsub("\u00A0",     "", raw_rob, fixed = TRUE)

HTML(raw_rob)
```



## Robustness: symmetric (placebo) phase × AIIE matrix

```{r symmetric}
fml_sym <- ln_lp ~ early_x_agg_x_intel_raw + mature_x_agg_x_intel_raw +
                   early_x_lm_x_intel_raw  + mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw  +
                   ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib + eng_contrib +
                   log_employment_lag1

m_sym <- plm(fml_sym, data = pdata, model = "within", effect = "twoways")

modelsummary(
  list("Two-way FE — symmetric matrix" = m_sym),
  vcov     = list(clse(m_sym)),
  coef_map = c(
    "early_x_agg_x_intel_raw"   = "Early × Aggregate × Intel  (focal)",
    "mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw"   = "Mature × LM × Intel        (focal)",
    "early_x_lm_x_intel_raw"    = "Early × LM × Intel         (placebo)",
    "mature_x_agg_x_intel_raw"  = "Mature × Aggregate × Intel (placebo)",
    "ict_capital_contrib"       = "ICT-capital contribution",
    "non_ict_capital_contrib"   = "Non-ICT capital contribution",
    "eng_contrib"               = "Energy contribution",
    "log_employment_lag1"       = "Log employment $_{t-1}$"
  ),
  gof_map = gof,
  stars   = c('*' = .1, '**' = .05, '***' = .01),
  title   = "Symmetric phase × AIIE matrix (placebo check)",
  output  = "kableExtra"
) %>%
```

# Discussion

# Full-panel regression table (1997–2024)

```{r build-full-panel}
# Re-building the panel on the full 1997–2024 window
panel_fp <- panel_raw %>%
  filter(industry != "Farms") %>%
  arrange(bea_code, year) %>%
  mutate(
    early_ai  = as.integer(year >= 2016 & year <= 2019),
    mature_ai = as.integer(year >= 2020),

    early_x_agg_x_intel_raw  = early_ai  * aggregate_raw_aiie * intelligence_index,
    mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw  = mature_ai * lm_raw_aiie        * intelligence_index,
    mature_x_ig_x_intel_raw  = mature_ai * ig_raw_aiie        * intelligence_index,

    # NEW: COVID period dummy and WFH × COVID interaction
    covid_dummy = as.integer(year %in% c(2020, 2021)),
    wfh_x_covid = wfh_index * covid_dummy,

    log_employment_lag1 = ifelse(is.na(employment_lag1) | employment_lag1 <= 0,
                                  NA_real_, log(employment_lag1))
  )
pdata_fp <- pdata.frame(panel_fp, index = c("bea_code", "year"))

cat("Full panel dimensions:\n")
cat("  Rows:", nrow(panel_fp), "\n")
cat("  Industries:", n_distinct(panel_fp$bea_code), "\n")
cat("  Years:", min(panel_fp$year), "–", max(panel_fp$year), "\n")
```

```{r reg-table-fullpanel, results='asis'}
# ── Formulas ──
fml_fp <- ln_lp ~ early_x_agg_x_intel_raw + mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw +
                  ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib + eng_contrib

fml_fp_lp_lag <- ln_lp ~ early_x_agg_x_intel_raw + mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw +
                         ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib +
                         eng_contrib + lag(ln_lp, 1) + wfh_x_covid

fml_fp_both_lags <- ln_lp ~ early_x_agg_x_intel_raw + mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw +
                            ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib +
                            eng_contrib + lag(ln_lp, 1) + log_employment_lag1 + wfh_x_covid

fml_fp_emp_only <- ln_lp ~ early_x_agg_x_intel_raw + mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw +
                           ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib +
                           eng_contrib + log_employment_lag1 + wfh_x_covid

fml_fp_wfh <- ln_lp ~ early_x_agg_x_intel_raw + mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw +
                      ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib + eng_contrib +
                      wfh_x_covid

# Five base specifications (no lags), full 1997–2024 panel 
m_pool_fp <- plm(fml_fp, data = pdata_fp, model = "pooling")
m_fd_fp   <- plm(fml_fp, data = pdata_fp, model = "fd")
m_ife_fp  <- plm(fml_fp, data = pdata_fp, model = "within", effect = "individual")
m_tfe_fp  <- plm(fml_fp, data = pdata_fp, model = "within", effect = "time")
m_2we_fp  <- plm(fml_fp, data = pdata_fp, model = "within", effect = "twoways")


# Column 6: adding LP lag 
m_2we_fp_lp <- plm(fml_fp_lp_lag, data = pdata_fp,
                   model = "within", effect = "twoways")

# Column 7: adding both LP lag and log_employment_lag1 
m_2we_fp_both <- plm(fml_fp_both_lags, data = pdata_fp,
                     model = "within", effect = "twoways")

# Column 8: adding only log_employment_lag1
m_2we_fp_emp <- plm(fml_fp_emp_only, data = pdata_fp,
                    model = "within", effect = "twoways")

# Column 9: spec (5) + WFH × COVID interaction 
m_2we_fp_wfh <- plm(fml_fp_wfh, data = pdata_fp,
                    model = "within", effect = "twoways")

# ── Cluster-robust SEs ──
vcov_fp <- list(
  "Pooled OLS"      = clse(m_pool_fp),
  "First Diff"      = clse(m_fd_fp),
  "Industry FE"     = clse(m_ife_fp),
  "Year FE"         = clse(m_tfe_fp),
  "Two-way FE"      = clse(m_2we_fp),
  "+ LP lag"        = clse(m_2we_fp_lp),
  "+ LP lag + emp." = clse(m_2we_fp_both),
  "+ emp. lag"      = clse(m_2we_fp_emp),
  "+ WFH × COVID"   = clse(m_2we_fp_wfh)
)

mods_fp <- list(
  "Pooled OLS"      = m_pool_fp,
  "First Diff"      = m_fd_fp,
  "Industry FE"     = m_ife_fp,
  "Year FE"         = m_tfe_fp,
  "Two-way FE"      = m_2we_fp,
  "+ LP lag"        = m_2we_fp_lp,
  "+ LP lag + emp." = m_2we_fp_both,
  "+ emp. lag"      = m_2we_fp_emp,
  "BASE + WFH"   = m_2we_fp_wfh
)

coef_map_fp <- c(
  "early_x_agg_x_intel_raw"  = "Early × Aggregate AIIE × Intel",
  "mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw"  = "Mature × LM AIIE × Intel",
  "wfh_x_covid"              = "WFH index × COVID dummy",
  "ict_capital_contrib"      = "ICT-capital contribution",
  "non_ict_capital_contrib"  = "Non-ICT capital contribution",
  "eng_contrib"              = "Energy contribution",
  "lag(ln_lp, 1)"            = "ln(LP)_t-1",
  "log_employment_lag1"      = "Log employment_t-1",
  "(Intercept)"              = "Constant"
)

gof_fp <- tibble::tribble(
  ~raw,            ~clean,            ~fmt,
  "nobs",          "Observations",    0,
  "r.squared",     "R²",              3,
  "adj.r.squared", "Adj. R²",         3
)

add_rows_fp <- tibble::tribble(
  ~term,                       ~`Pooled OLS`, ~`First Diff`,    ~`Industry FE`, ~`Year FE`, ~`Two-way FE`, ~`+ LP lag`, ~`+ LP lag + emp.`, ~`+ emp. lag`, ~`BASE + WFH`,
  "Industry fixed effects",    "No",          "Differenced out","Yes",          "No",       "Yes",         "Yes",       "Yes",              "Yes",         "Yes",
  "Year fixed effects",        "No",          "No",             "No",           "Yes",      "Yes",         "Yes",       "Yes",              "Yes",         "Yes",
  "Sample years",              "1997–2024",   "1997–2024",      "1997–2024",    "1997–2024","1997–2024",   "1998–2024", "2017–2024",        "2017–2024",   "1997–2024",
  "SE cluster",                "Industry",    "Industry",       "Industry",     "Industry", "Industry",    "Industry",  "Industry",         "Industry",    "Industry"
)
attr(add_rows_fp, "position") <- NULL

raw_fp <- modelsummary(
  mods_fp,
  vcov         = vcov_fp,
  coef_map     = coef_map_fp,
  gof_map      = gof_fp,
  add_rows     = add_rows_fp,
  stars        = c('*' = .1, '**' = .05, '***' = .01),
  title        = "AI Exposure and Labor Productivity — Full panel (1997–2024) build-up (clustered SEs in parentheses)",
  notes        = c(
    "Dependent variable: ln(LP) — log of the BLS labor productivity index.",
    "Columns (1)–(5) drop both the LP lag and lagged employment, allowing the full 1997–2024 panel.",
    "Column (6) adds ln(LP)_{t-1}; first-year observations drop because of the lag.",
    "Column (7) adds both ln(LP)_{t-1} and log(employment)_{t-1}; lagged employment is unavailable pre-2016, mechanically reducing the sample to 2017–2024.",
    "Column (8) adds only log(employment)_{t-1}; same 2017–2024 restriction as (7) but without the LP lag (matches the original 2016–2024 baseline).",
    "Pre-2016 observations contribute zero to the AI interactions by construction.",
    "Standard errors clustered at the industry level (HC1).",
    "Column (9) augments specification (5) with WFH × COVID, where COVID = 1 for 2020–2021 and 0 otherwise. The COVID dummy alone is absorbed by year FE; identification of the interaction comes from cross-industry variation in WFH exposure during the 2020–2021 window."
  ),
  output = "kableExtra"
) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                position = "center") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "(1)" = 1, "(2)" = 1, "(3)" = 1, "(4)" = 1,
                   "(5)" = 1, "(6)" = 1, "(7)" = 1, "(8)" = 1, "(9)" = 1)) %>%
  as.character()

# Strip the leaked non-breaking spaces (same fix as elsewhere)
raw_fp <- gsub("&amp;nbsp;", "", raw_fp, fixed = TRUE)
raw_fp <- gsub("&nbsp;",     "", raw_fp, fixed = TRUE)
raw_fp <- gsub("\u00A0",     "", raw_fp, fixed = TRUE)

htmltools::HTML(raw_fp)
```

# Collinearity diagnostics for column (7)

```{r vif-collinearity, results='asis'}
# 1. Within-transformed correlation matrix
fe_demean <- function(x, ind, time) {
  d <- ave(x, ind,  FUN = function(v) v - mean(v, na.rm = TRUE))
  d <- ave(d, time, FUN = function(v) v - mean(v, na.rm = TRUE))
  d
}

df_check <- model.frame(m_2we_fp_both)
ind   <- as.character(index(m_2we_fp_both, "id"))
time  <- as.character(index(m_2we_fp_both, "time"))

X_within <- sapply(df_check[, -1, drop = FALSE],
                   fe_demean, ind = ind, time = time)

cor_within <- cor(X_within, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

# Mapping raw variable names 
nice_names <- c(
  "early_x_agg_x_intel_raw"  = "Early × Agg × Intel",
  "mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw"  = "Mature × LM × Intel",
  "ict_capital_contrib"      = "ICT-capital contrib.",
  "non_ict_capital_contrib"  = "Non-ICT capital contrib.",
  "eng_contrib"              = "Energy contrib.",
  "lag(ln_lp, 1)"            = "ln(LP) t-1",
  "log_employment_lag1"      = "Log emp. t-1"
)
rownames(cor_within) <- nice_names[rownames(cor_within)]
colnames(cor_within) <- nice_names[colnames(cor_within)]

# 2. Variance inflation factors via LSDV 
if (!requireNamespace("car", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("car")
library(car)

lsdv <- lm(
  ln_lp ~ early_x_agg_x_intel_raw + mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw +
          ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib + eng_contrib +
          lag(ln_lp, 1) + log_employment_lag1 +
          factor(bea_code) + factor(year),
  data = panel_fp
)

vif_raw <- car::vif(lsdv)

# Dropping the FE dummies from the VIF table
keep <- c("early_x_agg_x_intel_raw", "mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw",
          "ict_capital_contrib", "non_ict_capital_contrib", "eng_contrib",
          "lag(ln_lp, 1)", "log_employment_lag1")
vif_tab <- tibble::tibble(
  Variable = unname(nice_names[keep]),
  VIF      = round(unname(vif_raw[keep]), 2),
  Verdict  = dplyr::case_when(
    VIF < 5  ~ "Fine",
    VIF < 10 ~ "Noteworthy",
    TRUE     ~ "Problem"
  )
)

kbl1 <- kable(round(cor_within, 3),
              caption = "Within-transformed pairwise correlations of regressors in column (7)",
              align   = "c") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, position = "left") |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

kbl2 <- kable(vif_tab,
              caption = "Variance-inflation factors (LSDV equivalent)",
              align   = c("l","r","l")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, position = "left") |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

print(kbl1); cat("\n\n"); print(kbl2)
```

# Period-dummy regression table

$$
\ln LP_{i,t} = \beta_1 \cdot \mathbf{1}[t \ge 2016]
            + \beta_2 \cdot \mathbf{1}[t \ge 2016] \times \text{AIIE}_{i,t}^{\text{agg,raw}} \times \text{Intel}_t
            + \boldsymbol{\gamma}'\mathbf{X}_{i,t} + \alpha_i + \delta_t + u_{i,t}
$$
# Period-dummy specification — Two-way FE with and without LP lag

$$
\ln LP_{i,t} = \beta_1 \cdot \mathbf{1}[t \ge 2016]
            + \beta_2 \cdot \mathbf{1}[t \ge 2016] \times \text{AIIE}_{i,t}^{\text{agg,raw}} \times \text{Intel}_t
            + \boldsymbol{\gamma}'\mathbf{X}_{i,t} + \alpha_i + \delta_t + u_{i,t}
$$


```{r build-period-panel}
panel_pd <- panel_raw %>%
  filter(industry != "Farms") %>%
  arrange(bea_code, year) %>%
  mutate(
    ai_period               = as.integer(year >= 2016),
    ai_period_x_agg_x_intel = ai_period * aggregate_raw_aiie * intelligence_index
  )
pdata_pd <- pdata.frame(panel_pd, index = c("bea_code", "year"))
```

```{r reg-table-period, results='asis'}
# ── Formulas ──
fml_pd <- ln_lp ~ ai_period + ai_period_x_agg_x_intel +
                  ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib + eng_contrib

fml_pd_lag <- ln_lp ~ ai_period + ai_period_x_agg_x_intel +
                       ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib + eng_contrib +
                       lag(ln_lp, 1)

# ── Two specifications ──
m_2we_pd     <- plm(fml_pd,     data = pdata_pd, model = "within", effect = "twoways")
m_2we_pd_lag <- plm(fml_pd_lag, data = pdata_pd, model = "within", effect = "twoways")

vcov_pd <- list(
  "Two-way FE" = clse(m_2we_pd),
  "+ LP lag"   = clse(m_2we_pd_lag)
)

mods_pd <- list(
  "Two-way FE" = m_2we_pd,
  "+ LP lag"   = m_2we_pd_lag
)

coef_map_pd <- c(
  "ai_period"                = "AI period $\\mathbf{1}[t \\ge 2016]$",
  "ai_period_x_agg_x_intel"  = "AI period × Aggregate AIIE × Intel",
  "ict_capital_contrib"      = "ICT-capital contribution",
  "non_ict_capital_contrib"  = "Non-ICT capital contribution",
  "eng_contrib"              = "Energy contribution",
  "lag(ln_lp, 1)"            = "ln(LP) $_{t-1}$",
  "(Intercept)"              = "Constant"
)

gof_pd <- tibble::tribble(
  ~raw,            ~clean,            ~fmt,
  "nobs",          "Observations",    0,
  "r.squared",     "R²",              3,
  "adj.r.squared", "Adj. R²",         3
)

add_rows_pd <- tibble::tribble(
  ~term,                       ~`Two-way FE`, ~`+ LP lag`,
  "Industry fixed effects",    "Yes",         "Yes",
  "Year fixed effects",        "Yes",         "Yes",
  "AI dummy absorbed by FE?",  "Yes",         "Yes",
  "Sample years",              "1997–2024",   "1998–2024",
  "SE cluster",                "Industry",    "Industry"
)
attr(add_rows_pd, "position") <- NULL

raw_pd <- modelsummary(
  mods_pd,
  vcov         = vcov_pd,
  coef_map     = coef_map_pd,
  gof_map      = gof_pd,
  add_rows     = add_rows_pd,
  stars        = c('*' = .1, '**' = .05, '***' = .01),
  title        = "Period-dummy specification — full panel (1997–2024)",
  notes        = c(
    "Dependent variable: ln(LP) — log of the BLS labor productivity index.",
    "AI period dummy = 1 if year ≥ 2016, 0 otherwise.",
    "The AI period dummy is purely time-varying and is therefore mechanically absorbed by year FE; both cells appear blank by construction.",
    "The triple interaction (AI period × Aggregate AIIE × Intel) is mechanically zero before 2016 — coefficient identified from 2016+ within-industry variation.",
    "Column (2) adds ln(LP)_{t-1}; first-year observations drop because of the lag.",
    "Standard errors clustered at the industry level (HC1)."
  ),
  output = "kableExtra"
) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                position = "center") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "(1)" = 1, "(2)" = 1)) %>%
  as.character()

raw_pd <- gsub("&amp;nbsp;", "", raw_pd, fixed = TRUE)
raw_pd <- gsub("&nbsp;",     "", raw_pd, fixed = TRUE)
raw_pd <- gsub("\u00A0",     "", raw_pd, fixed = TRUE)

htmltools::HTML(raw_pd)
```

```{r vif-table, results='asis'}
vif_raw <- vif(lm(
  ln_lp ~ early_x_agg_x_intel_raw + mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw +
          ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib + eng_contrib +

))

nice_names <- c(
  "early_x_agg_x_intel_raw"  = "Early × Aggregate AIIE × Intel",
```

```{r}
# ── Knobs (tune to taste) ───────────────────────────────────────
resid_threshold <- 1.5    
extreme_pctile  <- 0.02  


panel_2020 <- panel_raw %>%
  filter(industry != "Farms", year == 2020,
         !is.na(wfh_index), !is.na(lp_index))

# OLS fit → standardised residuals (= residual / SE), so the threshold is
# unitless and roughly comparable to a z-score
fit_2020 <- lm(lp_index ~ wfh_index, data = panel_2020)

panel_2020 <- panel_2020 %>%
  mutate(
    std_resid = rstandard(fit_2020),
    is_label  = abs(std_resid) > resid_threshold |
                wfh_index >= quantile(wfh_index, 1 - extreme_pctile) |
                wfh_index <= quantile(wfh_index,     extreme_pctile) |
                lp_index  >= quantile(lp_index,  1 - extreme_pctile) |
                lp_index  <= quantile(lp_index,      extreme_pctile)
  )

cor_2020 <- cor(panel_2020$wfh_index, panel_2020$lp_index)

p_scatter <- ggplot(panel_2020, aes(x = wfh_index, y = lp_index)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
              color = "steelblue", fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_point(aes(color = is_label), size = 2.6, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = filter(panel_2020, is_label),
    aes(label = industry, color = is_label),
    size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf,
    segment.color = "grey55", segment.alpha = 0.6,
    box.padding = 0.45, min.segment.length = 0,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "firebrick", `FALSE` = "steelblue"),
                     guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title    = "Work-from-home capacity vs labor productivity, 2020",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Pearson r = %.3f · Labelled (red): |std. resid.| > %g or top/bottom %g%% on either axis",
      cor_2020, resid_threshold, extreme_pctile * 100),
    x = "WFH index (industry-level WFH feasibility)",
    y = "lp_index (2017 = 100)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p_scatter)
```



# Additional Specification Tests


## Panel unit root test

```{r unit-root}
library(plm)
library(kableExtra)

# Im-Pesaran-Shin panel unit root test on ln(LP)

ips_trend <- purtest(pdata$ln_lp, test = "ips", exo = "trend",
                     lags = "AIC", pmax = 2)

ips_const <- purtest(pdata$ln_lp, test = "ips", exo = "intercept",
                     lags = "AIC", pmax = 2)

ips_fd    <- purtest(diff(pdata$ln_lp), test = "ips", exo = "intercept",
                     lags = "AIC", pmax = 2)

ur_table <- tibble::tibble(
  Series      = c("ln(LP) — with trend",
                  "ln(LP) — with intercept only",
                  "Δln(LP) — first difference"),
  `W-bar stat` = c(
    round(ips_trend$statistic$statistic,  3),
    round(ips_const$statistic$statistic,  3),
    round(ips_fd$statistic$statistic,     3)
  ),
  `p-value` = c(
    formatC(ips_trend$statistic$p.value, digits = 4, format = "g"),
    formatC(ips_const$statistic$p.value, digits = 4, format = "g"),
    formatC(ips_fd$statistic$p.value,    digits = 4, format = "g")
  ),
  Decision = c(
    ifelse(ips_trend$statistic$p.value < 0.05,
           "Reject H0 — stationary", "Fail to reject — unit root"),
    ifelse(ips_const$statistic$p.value < 0.05,
           "Reject H0 — stationary", "Fail to reject — unit root"),
    ifelse(ips_fd$statistic$p.value    < 0.05,
           "Reject H0 — stationary", "Fail to reject — unit root")
  ),
  Implication = c(
    "Levels regression is valid",
    "Levels regression is valid",
    "ln(LP) is I(1); first-differences spec preferred"
  )
)

kable(ur_table,
      caption = "Im-Pesaran-Shin panel unit root tests",
      align   = c("l","r","r","l","l")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, position = "left") |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |>
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "H0: all panels contain a unit root (IPS test).",
      "Lag length selected by AIC, maximum 2 lags.",
      "If ln(LP) has a unit root but Δln(LP) does not, the series is I(1).",
      "In that case the first-differences estimator is preferred over the levels FE.",
      "Rejection for Δln(LP) confirms it is stationary regardless of the levels result."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes:"
  )
```


## Pre-trend test (parallel trends)

```{r pre-trend-setup}

panel_es <- panel_raw %>%
  filter(industry != "Farms") %>%
  arrange(bea_code, year) %>%
  group_by(bea_code) %>%
  mutate(
    aiie_fixed = max(aggregate_raw_aiie, na.rm = TRUE),
    aiie_fixed = ifelse(is.infinite(aiie_fixed), NA_real_, aiie_fixed)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(aiie_fixed))

years_to_interact <- sort(setdiff(unique(panel_es$year), 2015))

for (yr in years_to_interact) {
  panel_es[[paste0("aiie_x_y", yr)]] <-
    as.integer(panel_es$year == yr) * panel_es$aiie_fixed
}

# Estimating the event-study model with two-way FE
es_terms   <- paste0("aiie_x_y", years_to_interact, collapse = " + ")
es_formula <- as.formula(paste0(
  "ln_lp ~ ", es_terms,
  " + ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib + eng_contrib",
  " + factor(bea_code) + factor(year)"
))

es_fit <- lm(es_formula, data = panel_es)
es_vcov <- sandwich::vcovCL(es_fit,
                            cluster = panel_es[["bea_code"]])
```

```{r pre-trend-plot}
library(ggplot2)

# Extracting coefficients and clustered SEs for each year interaction
es_rows <- paste0("aiie_x_y", years_to_interact)
present  <- intersect(es_rows, rownames(lmtest::coeftest(es_fit, vcov = es_vcov)))

es_coefs <- tibble::tibble(
  year  = as.integer(gsub("aiie_x_y", "", present)),
  coef  = lmtest::coeftest(es_fit, vcov = es_vcov)[present, "Estimate"],
  se    = lmtest::coeftest(es_fit, vcov = es_vcov)[present, "Std. Error"]
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lo = coef - 1.96 * se, hi = coef + 1.96 * se) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    tibble::tibble(year = 2015L, coef = 0, se = 0, lo = 0, hi = 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(year)

ggplot(es_coefs, aes(x = year, y = coef)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2015.5, linetype = "dotted", colour = "red",
             linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
                width = 0.3, colour = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, colour = "navy") +
  annotate("text", x = 2013, y = max(es_coefs$hi, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9,
           label = "Pre-period\n(should be ≈ 0)", colour = "grey30",
           size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 2020, y = max(es_coefs$hi, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9,
           label = "Post-2015\n(AI era)", colour = "grey30", size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1998, 2024, 2)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Event study: productivity response to AI exposure",
    subtitle = "AIIE × year dummy | 2015 = reference year | 95% CI clustered by industry",
    x = "Year", y = "Estimated effect on ln(LP)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
        plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r pre-trend-ftest}
# Joint F-test

pre_terms <- paste0("aiie_x_y", years_to_interact[years_to_interact < 2016])

pre_trend_test <- car::linearHypothesis(
  es_fit,
  paste0(pre_terms, " = 0"),
  vcov. = es_vcov,
  test  = "F"
)

pt_table <- tibble::tibble(
  Hypothesis  = "All pre-2016 AIIE × year = 0",
  `F-stat`    = round(pre_trend_test$F[2], 3),
  df1         = pre_trend_test$Df[2],
  df2         = pre_trend_test$Res.Df[2],
  `p-value`   = formatC(pre_trend_test$`Pr(>F)`[2], digits = 4, format = "g"),
  Decision    = ifelse(
    pre_trend_test$`Pr(>F)`[2] < 0.05,
    "Reject H0 — pre-trends differ (identification concern)",
    "Fail to reject — parallel trends holds"
  )
)

kable(pt_table,
      caption = "Pre-trend F-test: joint significance of pre-2016 AIIE × year coefficients",
      align   = c("l","r","r","r","r","l")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, position = "left") |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |>
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "H0: all pre-2016 AIIE × year interaction coefficients equal zero simultaneously.",
      "Reference year: 2015. Standard errors clustered at the industry level.",
      "Failure to reject supports the parallel-trends assumption underlying the",
      "difference-in-differences identification strategy."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes:"
  )
```


## System GMM (dynamic panel)

```{r gmm-estimate}
library(plm)

# System GMM formula syntax in pgmm()
m_gmm <- pgmm(
  ln_lp ~ lag(ln_lp, 1) +
          early_x_agg_x_intel_raw + mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw +
          ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib + eng_contrib +
          log_employment_lag1
  | lag(ln_lp, 2:3)
  | early_x_agg_x_intel_raw + mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw +
    ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib +
    eng_contrib + log_employment_lag1,
  data           = pdata,
  effect         = "twoways",
  model          = "twosteps",
  transformation = "ld"
)

cat("=== SYSTEM GMM (Blundell-Bond) ===\n")
print(summary(m_gmm, robust = TRUE))


n_instr  <- length(unlist(m_gmm$instruments))
n_groups <- n_distinct(panel$bea_code)
cat("\nInstruments:", n_instr, "| Groups:", n_groups)
if (n_instr > n_groups) {
  cat(" — WARNING: too many instruments; reduce to lag(ln_lp, 2:3)\n")
} else {
  cat(" — OK\n")
}
```

```{r gmm-validity-tests}
# Arellano-Bond tests via explicit residual autocorrelation.


# Sargan-Hansen overidentification test
sargan_test <- sargan(m_gmm)

# Manual AR(1) test on GMM residuals
gmm_resid_vec <- unlist(residuals(m_gmm))

gmm_index <- pdata %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(bea_code, year) %>%
  arrange(bea_code, year) %>%
  group_by(bea_code) %>%
  slice(-1) %>%
  ungroup()

if (length(gmm_resid_vec) != nrow(gmm_index)) {
  gmm_index <- data.frame(
    bea_code = gsub("-.*", "", names(gmm_resid_vec)),
    year     = as.integer(gsub(".*-", "", names(gmm_resid_vec)))
  )
}

resid_df <- gmm_index %>%
  mutate(resid = gmm_resid_vec) %>%
  arrange(bea_code, year) %>%
  group_by(bea_code) %>%
  mutate(resid_lag1 = lag(resid, 1)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(resid_lag1))

ar1_fit  <- lm(resid ~ resid_lag1, data = resid_df)
ar1_test <- lmtest::coeftest(ar1_fit,
             vcov = sandwich::vcovCL(ar1_fit,
                    cluster = resid_df$bea_code))
p_ar1    <- ar1_test[2, 4]
stat_ar1 <- ar1_test[2, 3]


ab_table <- tibble::tibble(
  Test      = c("AR(1) in residuals",
                "AR(2) in residuals",
                "Sargan-Hansen J-test"),
  Statistic = c(round(stat_ar1, 3),
                "—",
                round(sargan_test$statistic, 3)),
  `p-value` = c(formatC(p_ar1, digits = 4, format = "g"),
                "not feasible",
                formatC(sargan_test$p.value, digits = 4, format = "g")),
  Required  = c("p < 0.05", "p > 0.05", "p > 0.05"),
  Decision  = c(
    ifelse(p_ar1 < 0.05,
           "Pass — serial correlation present (expected)",
           "Unexpected — check model"),
    "Aliased out — perfect MA(1) in GMM residuals (see note)",
    ifelse(sargan_test$p.value > 0.05,
           "Pass — instruments valid",
           "Reject — instruments may be invalid")
  )
)

kable(ab_table,
      caption = "GMM validity tests — AR and overidentification",
      align   = c("l","r","r","r","l")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, position = "left") |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |>
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "AR(1): serial correlation in GMM residuals is expected and not a problem.",
      "AR(2): not feasible — System GMM differencing induces perfect MA(1) structure",
      "       in the residuals (resid_lag1 coefficient = 1.0 exactly), causing",
      "       resid_lag2 to be aliased out of the AR(2) regression.",
      "       Instrument validity is instead assessed via the Sargan-Hansen test.",
      "Sargan-Hansen: H0 is that all instruments are uncorrelated with the error term.",
      "Note: Sargan test loses power when instrument count approaches group count (59)."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes:"
  )


p_ar2 <- NA_real_
```

```{r gmm-long-run}
# Short-run and long-run AI effects 

coefs_gmm <- coef(m_gmm)
rho       <- coefs_gmm["lag(ln_lp, 1)"]
rho_fe    <- coef(m_2weNEW)["lag(ln_lp, 1)"]

cat("=== PERSISTENCE COEFFICIENT ===\n")
cat("rho (GMM):", round(rho,    4), "\n")
cat("rho (FE): ", round(rho_fe, 4),
    " — expect FE < GMM due to Nickell bias\n")
cat("Long-run multiplier: 1 / (1 -", round(rho, 2), ") =",
    round(1 / (1 - rho), 2), "\n")

if (rho >= 1) cat("WARNING: rho >= 1 implies unit root\n")
if (rho <= 0) cat("WARNING: rho <= 0 is economically implausible\n")

# Long-run effects table
ai_terms <- c("early_x_agg_x_intel_raw", "mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw")
ai_labels <- c("Early × Aggregate AIIE × Intel",
               "Mature × LM AIIE × Intel")

lr_table <- tibble::tibble(
  Term            = ai_labels,
  `SR (GMM)`      = round(coefs_gmm[ai_terms], 4),
  `LR (GMM)`      = round(coefs_gmm[ai_terms] / (1 - rho), 4),
  `SR (FE)`       = round(coef(m_2weNEW)[ai_terms], 4),
  `LR multiplier` = round(1 / (1 - rho), 2)
)

kable(lr_table,
      caption = "System GMM: short-run and long-run AI effects",
      align   = c("l","r","r","r","r")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, position = "left") |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |>
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "SR = short-run (one-period) coefficient from System GMM.",
      "LR = long-run effect = SR / (1 - rho); cumulative effect once full adjustment plays out.",
      "FE SR shown for comparison — Nickell bias pushes rho downward in FE.",
      "Similar SR coefficients between FE and GMM indicate Nickell bias is not driving results."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes:"
  )
```

## Skill heterogeneity: does the AI effect differ by workforce education?

```{r skill-heterogeneity}
library(car)

# Compute median college share across the working panel
# Use the time-average per industry so the split is stable
median_college <- panel %>%
  group_by(bea_code) %>%
  summarise(avg_college = mean(college_share, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  summarise(med = median(avg_college, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(med)

cat("Median college share (time-averaged):", round(median_college, 3), "\n")

# Add skill group and interaction terms to the working panel
panel_skill <- panel %>%
  group_by(bea_code) %>%
  mutate(avg_college = mean(college_share, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    # high_skill = 1 if the industry's average college share is above median
    high_skill = as.integer(avg_college >= median_college),

    # Interacted mature AI term — key coefficient of interest
    # H2: beta on mature_lm_highskill > beta on mature_lm_lowskill
    mature_lm_highskill = mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw * high_skill,
    mature_lm_lowskill  = mature_x_lm_x_intel_raw * (1 - high_skill),

    # Early AI term split (for completeness)
    early_agg_highskill = early_x_agg_x_intel_raw * high_skill,
    early_agg_lowskill  = early_x_agg_x_intel_raw * (1 - high_skill)
  )

pdata_skill <- pdata.frame(panel_skill, index = c("bea_code", "year"))

# Heterogeneous-effect model:
# The focal AI terms are replaced by their skill-split versions.
# This lets the early and mature AI effects differ between
# high-skill and low-skill industries.
m_skill <- plm(
  ln_lp ~ early_agg_highskill + early_agg_lowskill +
          mature_lm_highskill + mature_lm_lowskill +
          ict_capital_contrib + non_ict_capital_contrib + eng_contrib +
          log_employment_lag1,
  data   = pdata_skill,
  model  = "within",
  effect = "twoways"
)

# Print with clustered SEs
ct_print(m_skill, "Two-way FE — skill heterogeneity split")

# Formal test: is mature AI effect significantly different across skill groups?
# H0: mature_lm_highskill = mature_lm_lowskill
# Rejection supports H2: AI is more labor-augmenting in high-skill industries
skill_wald <- car::linearHypothesis(
  m_skill,
  "mature_lm_highskill = mature_lm_lowskill",
  vcov. = clse(m_skill),
  test  = "Chisq"
)

skill_table <- tibble::tibble(
  Coefficient        = c("Mature AI — high skill industries",
                         "Mature AI — low skill industries",
                         "Difference (high − low)"),
  Estimate           = c(
    round(coef(m_skill)["mature_lm_highskill"], 4),
    round(coef(m_skill)["mature_lm_lowskill"],  4),
    round(coef(m_skill)["mature_lm_highskill"] -
          coef(m_skill)["mature_lm_lowskill"],  4)
  ),
  `SE (clustered)`   = c(
    round(sqrt(clse(m_skill)["mature_lm_highskill",
                              "mature_lm_highskill"]), 4),
    round(sqrt(clse(m_skill)["mature_lm_lowskill",
                              "mature_lm_lowskill"]),  4),
    NA_real_
  ),
  Note = c(
    "Above-median college share industries",
    "Below-median college share industries",
    sprintf("Wald Chi2 = %.3f, p = %s",
            skill_wald$Chisq[2],
            formatC(skill_wald$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2], digits = 4, format = "g"))
  )
)

kable(skill_table,
      caption = "Skill heterogeneity: mature AI effect by workforce education",
      align   = c("l","r","r","l")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, position = "left") |>
  row_spec(3, bold = TRUE) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |>
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "High-skill: industries with above-median time-averaged college share.",
      "Low-skill: industries with below-median time-averaged college share.",
      paste0("Median college share used for split: ",
             round(median_college, 3), "."),
      "Wald test H0: mature AI coefficient is equal across skill groups.",
      "Rejection supports H2: AI augmentation is stronger in high-skill industries."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes:"
  )
```

## Summary of all specification tests

```{r test-summary}

p_ips_trend <- ips_trend$statistic$p.value
p_ips_const <- ips_const$statistic$p.value
p_pretrend  <- pre_trend_test$`Pr(>F)`[2]
p_skill     <- skill_wald$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]


p_ife_vs_pool <- as.numeric(pFtest(m_ife, m_pool)$p.value)
p_tfe_vs_pool <- as.numeric(pFtest(m_tfe, m_pool)$p.value)
p_2we_vs_pool <- as.numeric(pFtest(m_2we, m_pool)$p.value)
p_serial      <- as.numeric(pbgtest(m_2we)$p.value)
p_csd_obj     <- try(pcdtest(m_2we, test = "cd"), silent = TRUE)
p_csd         <- if (!inherits(p_csd_obj, "try-error"))
                   as.numeric(p_csd_obj$p.value) else NA_real_

master <- tibble::tibble(
  Section    = c(
    rep("Fixed Effects", 3),
    "Serial Correlation",
    "Cross-Sectional Dependence",
    rep("Unit Root", 2),
    "Pre-Trend",
    rep("GMM Validity", 2),
    "Skill Heterogeneity"
  ),
  Test       = c(
    "Industry FE vs Pooled OLS",
    "Year FE vs Pooled OLS",
    "Two-way FE vs Pooled OLS",
    "Breusch-Godfrey / Wooldridge AR(1)",
    "Pesaran CD",
    "IPS unit root — ln(LP) with trend",
    "IPS unit root — ln(LP) with intercept",
    "Pre-trend joint F-test (pre-2016)",
    "Arellano-Bond AR(1)",
    "Arellano-Bond AR(2)",
    "Mature AI: high-skill = low-skill"
  ),
  H0         = c(
    "No industry effects",
    "No time effects",
    "No two-way effects",
    "No AR(1) serial correlation",
    "Cross-sectional independence",
    "Unit root in ln(LP)",
    "Unit root in ln(LP)",
    "Parallel pre-trends hold",
    "No AR(1) in differences",
    "No AR(2) in differences",
    "Skill groups have equal AI effect"
  ),
  `p-value`  = c(
    formatC(p_ife_vs_pool, digits = 4, format = "g"),
    formatC(p_tfe_vs_pool, digits = 4, format = "g"),
    formatC(p_2we_vs_pool, digits = 4, format = "g"),
    formatC(p_serial,      digits = 4, format = "g"),
    ifelse(is.na(p_csd), "—",
           formatC(p_csd, digits = 4, format = "g")),
    formatC(p_ips_trend,   digits = 4, format = "g"),
    formatC(p_ips_const,   digits = 4, format = "g"),
    formatC(p_pretrend,    digits = 4, format = "g"),
  ifelse(is.na(p_ar2), "—", formatC(p_ar2, digits = 4, format = "g")),
    ifelse(is.na(p_ar2), "—", formatC(p_ar2, digits = 4, format = "g")),
    formatC(p_skill,       digits = 4, format = "g")
  ),
  Decision   = c(
    ifelse(p_ife_vs_pool < 0.05, "Reject H0", "Fail to reject"),
    ifelse(p_tfe_vs_pool < 0.05, "Reject H0", "Fail to reject"),
    ifelse(p_2we_vs_pool < 0.05, "Reject H0", "Fail to reject"),
    ifelse(p_serial      < 0.05, "Reject H0", "Fail to reject"),
    ifelse(is.na(p_csd), "—",
           ifelse(p_csd < 0.05, "Reject H0", "Fail to reject")),
    ifelse(p_ips_trend   < 0.05, "Reject H0", "Fail to reject"),
    ifelse(p_ips_const   < 0.05, "Reject H0", "Fail to reject"),
    ifelse(p_pretrend    < 0.05, "Reject H0 (concern)", "Fail to reject"),
    ifelse(p_ar1         < 0.05, "Reject H0 (expected)", "Unexpected"),
   ifelse(is.na(p_ar2),
       "Not feasible — see GMM notes",
       ifelse(p_ar2 > 0.05,
              "Fail to reject (pass)",
              "Reject H0 (fail)")),
    ifelse(p_skill       < 0.05, "Reject H0 (heterogeneity)", "Fail to reject")
  )
)

kable(master,
      caption = "Master summary of all specification tests",
      align   = c("l","l","l","r","l")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, position = "left") |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |>
  pack_rows("Fixed Effects Justification", 1, 3) |>
  pack_rows("Serial Correlation",          4, 4) |>
  pack_rows("Cross-Sectional Dependence",  5, 5) |>
  pack_rows("Unit Root",                   6, 7) |>
  pack_rows("Pre-Trend / Parallel Trends", 8, 8) |>
  pack_rows("GMM Validity",                9, 10) |>
  pack_rows("Skill Heterogeneity (H2)",   11, 11) |>
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "All FE and serial correlation tests use the preferred two-way FE model (m_2we).",
      "Pre-trend test: H0 is that all pre-2016 AIIE × year coefficients equal zero.",
      "AR(1) rejection is expected and does not indicate a problem.",
      "AR(2) non-rejection is required for GMM instrument validity.",
      "Skill split uses median time-averaged college share as the threshold."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes:"
  )
```
